name: volleyball-clipper
description: AllSportsLive VOLLEYBALL Clipper - its own local program next to vMix (VolleyballClipper.exe, port 5007, asl-vb-clipper://): every volleyball point becomes a 10 s clip (7 s before / 3 s after the point) cut from the vMix recording, filed by set and player, uploaded to the website. Completely separate from the Cricket Clipper (clipper-helper/, ClipperHelper.exe).

scripts.build: node vb-build-guard.js && pkg volleyball-clipper-server.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output VolleyballClipper.exe
